Configuration

Widget reads widget.toml from the working directory at startup. Every key has a default, so an empty file is a valid configuration.

Listen address

The listen key sets the host and port Widget binds, for example listen = "127.0.0.1:8080".

Environment variables

Every key in widget.toml can be overridden with an environment variable: upper-case the key and prefix it with WIDGET_, so WIDGET_LISTEN overrides listen. Environment variables win over the file.

WIDGET_LISTEN=0.0.0.0:9000 widget serve

Logging

Set log_level to debug, info, warn or error. Logs go to standard error.
